terra.problem: The men sent home are those whose houses are not yet dedicated, whose vineyards they have not yet begun to enjoy, or who have not yet married the women to whom they are pledged.
The people must also open their gates; the verses say the people, not the city itself, become forced laborers.
The trees permitted for siege works are those known not to produce fruit, not just trees currently without fruit.
